title: AlFursan Credit Card Partners | Saudia
desc: Discover Alfursan credit card partners and earn miles faster with everyday spending. Compare card benefits and apply today. Boost your rewards with Saudia Alfursan credit cards.
html:
Credit Cards

 

MORE REASONS TO JOIN

Up to 300,000 bonus Miles on AlFursan Miles earning credit cards
Enjoy More

One way we are bringing more Miles to our members is by improving our credit card partner offers so members can earn Miles on the ground.

You will receive more Miles for every SAR as we have significantly improved the earn rates with our banking partners, giving you more value from your AlFursan Miles earning credit card.

Furthermore, to add even more value to the enhanced AlFursan program, our credit card partners are offering up to 300,000 Miles in joining and spending bonuses.

AlFursan anb Infinite Credit Card

Enjoy more than 250,000 Miles

Earn 1 Reward Mile for every SAR 2 spent on International transactions and 1 Reward Mile for every SAR 3 spent on local transactions. You will receive 30,000 Welcome Miles when you activate the card and spend SAR 5,000 in the first 30 days*. On top of that, you can earn 20,000 bonus Miles when you spend SAR 35,000 every 3 months*.

Explore the world with the AlFursan anb Infinite Credit Cards.

Annual fee: SAR 2,000 + VAT

Apply now

alrajhi bank AlFursan Credit Cards

Enjoy up to 170,000 Reward Miles

Enjoy up to 1 Reward Mile for every SAR 2 spent on internationals transactions with alrajhi bank’s AlFursan Miles earning credit cards. And earn up to 170,000 Miles when you activate the card and meet the spending requirements.

For offer validity details, please visit alrajhi bank website.

Annual fee: SAR 1,000 + VAT

Apply now

Riyad Bank AlFursan Infinite Credit Card

Enjoy up to 125,000 Reward Miles

Enjoy up to 1 Reward Mile for every SAR 2.5 on local transactions, and up to 1 Reward Mile for every SAR 1 spent on international transactions with Riyad Bank’s AlFursan Miles earning credit cards. When you activate your cards, you’ll earn up to 45,000 Reward Miles. You will also earn up to 20,000 Reward Miles when you spend SAR 40,000, every three months, totaling 125,000 Miles. You can earn 100% more Tier Credits on all Saudia bookings with terms and conditions applied.

Annual fee: SAR 2,000 + VAT

Apply now

Alinma AlFursan Infinite Credit Card

Enjoy 135,000+ Reward Miles and unlock a world of benefits

Enjoy up to 1 Reward Mile for every SAR 2.5 on local transactions, as well as up to 1 Reward Mile for every SAR 1 spent on international transactions with Alinma AlFursan credit cards. Earn up to 45,000 Reward Miles upon activation and qualifying spend, and up to 90,000+ Reward Miles when you meet the required monthly spend over the year. enjoy up to 4 AlFursan guest lounge passes annually with the Infinite card, subject to international spending requirements. 

Annual fee: SAR 2,000 + VAT

Apply now

AlFursan SAB BLACK Mastercard Credit Card

Earn up to 170,000 bonus Miles and fast track to Silver Tier!

Build towards your next Reward Ticket and earn up to 1 AlFursan Mile for every 2 SAR you spend using AlFursan credit card. If you successfully sign up for a new card you will receive up to 170,000 Miles when you activate and meet the spending requirements, while also getting fast tracked to the AlFursan Silver Tier with 50% additional Tier Credits with T&Cs applied.

Annual fee: SAR 1,950 + VAT

Apply now

BSF AlFursan Infinite Credit Card

Fast Track to the Silver Tier

Build your AlFursan Miles balance on the ground with the Banque Saudi Fransi AlFursan credit cards. Cardholders are eligible to earn up to 1 AlFursan Mile for as little as a SAR 1.5 spent on the card. quaterly spend bonus 30,000 Miles when spending 40,000 SAR , Fast track to silver tier for every 5 reward Miles equales one tier credit maximum 15,000 tier credits.

Annual fee: SAR 2,000 + VAT

Apply now

AlFursan American Express Credit Card

Earn up to 25,000 bonus Miles and fast track to Silver Tier!

Fly sooner when you earn 1 AlFursan Mile for every 1 USD spent, and 2 Miles for every 1 USD spent in all other currencies. You will also earn 2 Miles for every 1 USD spent on Saudia flights at Saudia.com. Additionally, you will be entitled to 10,000 bonus Miles when you spend USD 3,000 in the first 90 days of card issuance, as well as a 15,000 Miles annual spend bonus when you spend USD 50,000 annually. On top of that, you’ll be fast tracked to the AlFursan Silver Tier if you complete one return international flight from the Kingdom on Saudia in the first 12 months!

Annual fee: USD 250 + VAT

Apply now

SNB AlFursan Infinite Credit Card

Earn 15,000 Miles when you join!

Collect Miles on everyday transactions and earn 1 Mile for every 2 SAR spent internationally, and 1 AlFursan Mile for every 3 SAR spent domestically. You are also entitled to a 15,000 Miles joining bonus when you successfully sign up for a SNB AlFursan Infinite credit card.

Annual fee: SAR 750 + VAT

Apply now
